prompt.project_info: Create a black-and-white high-fashion editorial portrait using an approved adult face reference and hard natural daylight shadows.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman using the required approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial features, and natural identity without retouching or changing facial structure. She wears a loose white blouse, raises one arm to hold her tousled hair, and gives an intense direct gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait with the raised arm and hair partially crossing the face, minimalist wall, sharp geometric daylight shadow cast behind the subject, raw uncluttered framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh high-contrast natural daylight highlights facial contours, hair, and blouse texture; monochrome cinematic treatment with dramatic defined shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: High-fashion editorial photography, black-and-white processing, sharp natural texture, realistic anatomy, high detail, no watermark or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Black-and-white high-fashion editorial portrait of an adult woman using the required approved-adult face reference, preserving her face, facial features, natural identity, and facial structure without retouching. She wears a loose white blouse, raises one arm to hold her tousled hair with strands partially covering her face, and gives an intense direct gaze. Minimalist wall, sharp natural daylight casting defined geometric shadows, harsh high-contrast lighting, realistic hair and fabric texture, raw dramatic artistic monochrome cinematic style.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, signature
